mentions.name: aichat
mentions.description: A command group for Claude Code, Codex CLI and similar CLI agents that enables continuing work from a session at full context usage by creating a new session and injecting session lineage pointers, so the agent and sub-agents can recover arbitrary full details from ancestor sessions without needing compacting.
mentions.problem: Sessions that hit full context usage normally require compacting, which loses detail.
mentions.audience: Users of Claude Code, Codex CLI and similar CLI coding agents
mentions.source_excerpt: an “aichat” command group that enables continuing work from a session that is at full context usage, by creating a new session and injecting session lineage pointers so the agent/sub-agent can recover arbitrary full details from ancestor sessions. So no more compacting needed.
